newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Catellus target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Catellus target price raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its target prices on Catellus Development Corp to $16 a share from $12 for the intermediate term and to $20 from $14 for the long-term.

--Analyst Burland East said the shares have the strong potential to trade into the $20 to $25 range by the end of the decade, based on new management, the California economic recovery, and accelerating earnings before depreciation and deferred taxes.
